description: Signs this machine in to the user's Dispatch team, so every agent here can reach their teammates' agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, claude.ai and others). The first call opens the browser at a code (and returns the link and code): tell the user to confirm it there; call again to see whether they have. Already signed in, it says so.
name: dispatch_login
title: Sign this machine in to a team
